about:
# KneecappedEditorPercentage
Editor percentage for the level editor, in 2.2. Based on a feature from older versions of BetterEdit for GD 2.1.

***NOTE: THIS MOD IS INTENTIONALLY INDEPENDENT FROM LARGER EDITOR MODS ON THE INDEX AFTER PRIVATE DISCUSSION WITH THEIR RESPECTIVE MOD DEVELOPERS. __ONLY PING AND HARASS THEM ON SOCIAL MEDIA IF YOU WANT TO WASTE EVERYONE'S TIME.__***

### Why a percentage ***__WON'T__*** be visible:
**(Or, why an Editor Percentage mod for 2.2 in any capacity took so long to arrive at all)**
- The level is a Platformer level
- Arrow Triggers/Gameplay Rotation Triggers are present
- Gameplay objects with the "Reverse" option enabled are present (jump orbs and jump pads)
- Spawn-triggered or touch-triggered End Triggers are present
  - End Triggers with neither options enabled become the object with the furthest X position.
- Objects teleporting the player across the X-axis are present (regardless of its actual settings):
  - Linkable teleportation portals (Object IDs 2064 and 2092)
  - The teleportation orb (Object ID 3022)
  - The Teleport Trigger (Object ID 3027)

Show the percentage:
- Below the slider (like in BetterEdit)
- During editor playtesting
- In the overlay manager

Change the font/scale/color/opacity/decimal point amount/position/anchor point for each label individually.

Based on the algorithm from BetterEdit v5, originally licensed under Boost Software License v1.

Shoutout to [onlycek](https://discord.com/users/616159244642680832) for being the straw that broke the camel's back.

This [Geode mod](https://geode-sdk.org) is licensed under LGPLv2. To report bugs or get help with using my mods, press the Discord button in the lower left corner.
